title: 第19章 叶云 你叫破喉咙也没人第20章 你玩够了吗
slug: 人在废丹房我以丹药证道成仙
content_zh:
黑衣女子手中的短刃，瞬间刺破叶云衣服，却在命中胸口之时，发出叮的一声尖锐之声。
眼看刀锋分毫未进，黑衣女子脸色微变，口中本能地惊呼出声。
“这是……护身法宝？！”
能够抵挡她这一击，明显还是品级不低的法宝，起码是在凡阶上品乃至极品！
这可超出她的预期，眼看一击未果，黑衣女子连忙就要抽身拉开距离。
可惜，叶云已是冷笑一声道。
“想跑？先吃我一击吧！”
他当即抬手轰出一拳，毫无悬念地命中黑衣女子，将其直接打飞了出去。
在这一拳之间，他身上所迸发出的玄气，也令倒飞出去的黑衣女子惊到了。
“这家伙，怎会是凝气十重？”
按照主人给予的情报，眼前的叶云，应该只是凝气五重。
结果可倒好，数字翻了一倍，两者的实力差距可还远不止一倍。
“情报有误，得赶快撤！”
黑衣女子立马做出判断，今晚的暗杀失败，必须要尽快脱身才行。
在空中的时候，她便收回祭出的金色旗子。
而很快，她飞出的身体已经砸在树上，发出砰的一声闷响。
虽然全身骨头像是要散架般，但她也顾不上这么多，立马就要抽身融入身后的黑暗之中。
可还没等她有所动作，就见前方一道青色剑芒飞掠而来，以极快的速度来到近前，抵在她的脖子之上。
“这位朋友，可不要乱动哦。”
叶云从前方走来，笑吟吟地望着黑衣女子。

显然，从这一刻起，胜负已有分晓。
眼看已无力脱身，黑衣女子竟是出乎预料，脖子迎着长剑而去，居然是想要在这自杀。
好在盯着她的叶云，立马将长剑收回一点，同时自己也冲上前去，一把掐住了对方的脖子。
“想自杀，可没那么容易。”
叶云冷哼一声，眼看黑衣女子还在挣扎，他干脆抬手将对方给打昏了过去。
等不久之后，黑衣女子再次醒来，就发现自己已被封住玄气，双手双脚也都被绳子绑住了。
在她身上的，武器都已经被卸了下来，完全成了毫无反抗能力的普通人。
甚至于，在绳子的捆绑下，她连站都站不起来，只能躺在地上。
而叶云就坐在一旁的石头上，把玩着从她身上摸来的储物袋，以及那一枚象征外门弟子身份的玉牌。
“外门弟子陈月是吧，说说吧，谁派你来的？”
闻言，陈月转过脸去，压根就不理会他的问话。
“不说话？”
见她不配合，叶云嗤笑一声道。
“也行，那我就把你送去执法殿，想来那里的师兄师姐，有的是办法让你开口说话。”
听到执法殿这三个字，陈月脸色才变了下，冷声道。
“没有人派我来，只是我看你不爽罢了。”
“笑死，咱们两个认识吗？”
叶云白了她一眼，自己一共也没认识几个人，更别说得罪人了。
如果要是因为丹药找上他，那不可能要直取他性命，起码会想着活捉他逼问如何得来。
看她又一言不发，叶云也没继续逼迫。

在思索一番后，他起身来到陈月身边盘腿坐下。
随后，叶云手指轻抚着她的下巴，笑吟吟道。
“其实不用想也知道，你是真传弟子陈天傲师兄派来的，也只有他会有杀我的动机。”
他口中的真传弟子陈天傲，便是那位墨如烟师姐的未婚夫。
content_en:
The short blade in the hand of the woman in black instantly pierced Ye Yun's clothes, but when it hit his chest, it made a sharp ding sound.
Seeing that the blade did not make any progress, the woman in black's face changed slightly, and she instinctively exclaimed.
"This is...a magic weapon for protection?!"
Being able to withstand her attack, it is obviously a magic weapon of high grade, at least high-grade or even top-grade in the mortal realm!
This was beyond her expectations. Seeing that the attack failed, the woman in black quickly pulled away and distanced herself.
Unfortunately, Ye Yun already sneered.
"Want to run? Take a hit from me first!"
He immediately raised his hand and punched out, hitting the woman in black without any suspense and sending her flying away.
During this punch, the mysterious energy bursting out of his body also shocked the woman in black who flew backwards.
"How can this guy be at the tenth level of Qi Condensation?"
According to the information given by his master, Ye Yun in front of him should only be at the fifth level of Qi Condensation.
The result was not good, the number doubled, but the gap in strength between the two was far more than doubled.
"The intelligence is wrong, we must evacuate immediately!"
The woman in black immediately judged that tonight's assassination failed and she must escape as soon as possible.
While in the air, she took back the golden flag she had offered.
And soon, her flying body hit the tree, making a muffled sound.
Although the bones in her body seemed to be falling apart, she didn't care so much and immediately wanted to withdraw and blend into the darkness behind her.
But before she could make a move, she saw a green sword light flying from the front, approaching at an extremely fast speed and pressing against her neck.
"My friend, please don't move."
Ye Yun came from the front and looked at the woman in black with a smile.
Obviously, from this moment on, the winner has been decided.
Seeing that she was unable to escape, the woman in black unexpectedly moved towards the sword with her neck, intending to commit suicide here.
Fortunately, Ye Yun, who was staring at her, immediately retracted his sword a little, and at the same time, he rushed forward and grabbed the opponent's neck.
"It's not that easy to commit suicide."
Ye Yun snorted coldly. Seeing that the woman in black was still struggling, he simply raised his hand and knocked her unconscious.
Not long after, the woman in black woke up again and found that her mysterious energy had been sealed, and her hands and feet were tied with ropes.
All the weapons on her body have been removed, and she has completely become an ordinary person without the ability to resist.
In fact, she couldn't even stand up under the rope and could only lie on the ground.
Ye Yun was sitting on the stone nearby, playing with the storage bag he took from her and the jade plaque that symbolized the identity of an outer disciple.
"Outer disciple Chen Yue, right? Tell me, who sent you here?"
Hearing this, Chen Yue turned her face away and ignored his question at all.
"Don't speak?"
Seeing that she was not cooperating, Ye Yun sneered.
"Okay, then I will send you to the Law Enforcement Hall. I think the senior brothers and sisters who come there will have many ways to get you to talk."
After hearing the words "Law Enforcement Palace", Chen Yue's expression changed and she said coldly.
"No one sent me here, I just saw that you were unhappy."
"It's so funny, do we know each other?"
Ye Yun rolled his eyes at her. He didn't know a few people in total, let alone offended anyone.
If they were to find him because of the elixir, it would be impossible to kill him directly. At least they would want to capture him alive and ask how to get it.
Seeing that she remained silent again, Ye Yun did not continue to press.
After thinking for a while, he stood up and sat down cross-legged next to Chen Yue.
Then, Ye Yun stroked her chin with his fingers and said with a smile.
"Actually, you don't need to think about it to know that you were sent by the true disciple, Senior Brother Chen Tian'ao, and he is the only one who would have the motive to kill me."
The true disciple Chen Tianao he mentioned was the fiancé of Senior Sister Mo Ruyan.
